purpose: Define the durable opportunity substrate needed for identical generic workers to discover distinct safe work without turning the queue into product authority or a second mutable worker-status plane.

queue_is: source of stable opportunity identities before worker execution
queue_is_not: Current, Human Accepted or Served authority
proof that a worker launched or finished
permission to cross owner, privacy or write-scope boundaries
authority_boundary.execution_truth: Claim, STARTED, RETURN and terminal evidence remain separate durable facts. Missing run means NOT_STARTED, never inferred execution.

opportunity_contract.identity_rule: opportunity_id is stable for one logical work intent. A semantically changed retry or replanned unit receives an explicit new generation/identity relationship instead of silently reusing an old attempt.
opportunity_contract.minimal_context_rule: Opportunity metadata references the smallest sufficient Working Set/context; it must not embed unrelated project/private payloads.

state_model.derivation_rule: READY/BLOCKED/INELIGIBLE are deterministic projections from PREPARED intent plus dependencies, blockers, owner/authority, privacy, tool/capability compatibility and current claim/run evidence. They are not hand-maintained status flags.

eligibility_rules: PREPARED is necessary but not sufficient for READY.
All hard dependencies must be satisfied or explicitly waived by the authorized owner.
No unresolved hard blocker may exist.
Worker capabilities/tools must satisfy the opportunity contract.
Privacy/export constraints must permit the selected worker/context path.
Allowed write scope must not collide with an active incompatible writer or violate owner authority.
An active non-stale exclusive claim makes the opportunity unavailable to other workers.
Priority never overrides authority, privacy, capability or collision constraints.
Every exclusion must carry a machine-readable reason so generic workers can deterministically skip unsuitable work.

claim_contract.principle: Separate logical opportunity, claim/dispatch intent, execution attempt and result evidence.
claim_contract.atomicity: The exclusive claim path must use an atomic create-if-absent, CAS or equivalent host primitive. Read-then-write without collision proof is insufficient.
claim_contract.freshness: A claim may become reclaimable only under an explicit stale policy backed by durable timestamps/evidence. Silence alone is not completion.
claim_contract.retry: Retry creates a new execution attempt with explicit predecessor/supersession lineage. Historical failed/stale attempts remain reopenable.
claim_contract.idempotence: Where execution can cause external side effects, retries require idempotency/side-effect receipts or a verified safe boundary before re-execution.

multi_root_rules: Project membership is explicit and does not imply authority over another root.
Global selection may rank eligible opportunities across roots only after per-root authority/privacy/tool filters pass.
A worker receives only the selected opportunity and its compiled Working Set, not the full global queue payload.
Shared-owner opportunities must resolve the shared owner before creating local duplicates.

planner_interface.gate: Final promotion/dedup/integration semantics remain gated on WI-BIG-09 Steward/Merger and WI-BIG-13 Goldens/Vaccines/falsification convergence.

required_falsification_tests: two workers race one READY opportunity and at most one exclusive claim succeeds
five workers race multiple READY opportunities and no substantive duplicate execution occurs
blocked dependency cannot be bypassed by higher priority
privacy-incompatible worker cannot claim even when queue is otherwise empty
missing run after PREPARED remains NOT_STARTED
claim without STARTED is distinguishable from active execution
RETURN without DONE remains visible as RETURNED_NOT_TERMINAL
stale claim can be reclaimed only by declared policy and preserves predecessor evidence
same durable inputs produce the same READY/BLOCKED eligibility and exclusion reasons
cross-root global allocation never leaks private context or creates authority by project membership
implementation_note: Exact runtime/compiler hook remains unresolved by current repository search. Preserve this as a contract candidate; implementation must extend existing derived Agent Network/runtime mechanisms where verified rather than create a competing authority plane.
promotion_gate: consume WI-BIG-09 durable RETURN or explicitly bound/stale it through valid policy
consume WI-BIG-13 durable RETURN or explicitly bound/stale it through valid policy
